observation.command:
DBPW='V5V5@QSBXM9R%@FT@67DVYG4PQ28R7MN'
echo "=== table count ==="
mariadb -uqisutu -p"$DBPW" qisutu -e "SELECT COUNT(*) AS tables FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='qisutu'" 2>&1
echo "=== admin account ==="
mariadb -uqisutu -p"$DBPW" qisutu -e "SELECT id, login, account_type, authentication_type, is_active, LEFT(password_hash,10) AS pw_hash FROM user_account WHERE id=1" 2>&1
echo "=== system settings ==="
mariadb -uqisutu -p"$DBPW" qisutu -e "SELECT setting_key, setting_value FROM system_setting" 2>&1 | head -12
echo "=== database_version ==="
mariadb -uqisutu -p"$DBPW" qisutu -e "SELECT * FROM database_version" 2>&1
